narrative: Hopes for a Strait of Hormuz deal drive a risk-on shift as US sanctions lift and crude prices retreat — gold higher +3.36% near $4,292; equities -0.14%; DXY -0.13%; VIX 16.2. JPY leads G10 (+1.53% avg) but faces pressure as USD/JPY holds at 157.62; the 275bp Fed-BoJ carry remains the dominant anchor despite a strong options put skew (25d RR -2.40). EUR/USD firms to 1.1550 on a +275bp USD carry advantage as the options market pays a 2.7pt premium for protection. Watch RBA Policy Meeting on August 11 for the next G10 catalyst.
